title: Read an artifact and act on it
user_outcome: The user hands over a document, a scan, a screenshot, a spreadsheet, a recording or a video, asks an ordinary question about it, and gets the right answer -- or, when the file is unusable, is told so plainly instead of being handed a confident guess.
scoring: Each sub-case is graded on its own and reported on its own. A-10 as a whole is a FAIL if any sub-case fails. Sub-cases are never averaged into a score: 'six of seven' hides which one of the seven a user would have been misled by.

fixture_quality_controls.why: A media fixture can be too degraded to be answerable, and charging that to the product would be dishonest. Two sub-cases therefore carry a control that is independent of the graded answer. If the control cannot be recovered, that sub-case is UNPROVEN and the fixture is rebuilt -- it is never a FAIL.
fixture_quality_controls.scanned_pdf: the control line 'OCR CONTROL LINE ZEBRA QUARTZ HALYARD', printed larger than everything else. Confirmed recoverable by tesseract --psm 6 on 2026-08-10.
fixture_quality_controls.audio: the control phrase 'harbour lantern nine', spoken in the opening line.

answers.fail_if: any number other than 1284, or no page cited

answers.answer: Asia Pacific missed by 0.9 points (94.1 against a 95.0 target) and Latin America missed by 1.2 points (restated to 93.8 against 95.0).
answers.fail_if: naming only Asia Pacific. That is what the table on page 2 alone says, and it is the specific wrong answer produced by not reading note 3 on page 4. Also fails if Latin America is given as 95.2 and called a pass.

answers.answer: 107 tickets per engineer (1,284 divided by 12 engineers).
answers.fail_if: any value other than 107, including 107.0 rounded from a different pair of numbers
any other total; 3,143 would mean the August column was summed

answers.answer: 14 November 2026 -- 60 days after the 15 September 2026 publication date.
answers.fail_if: any other date. Failing to combine the publication date on page 1 with the 60-day rule on page 4 is the point of the question.

text_pdf.pass_condition: All five answers correct and each carries the page it came from.
text_pdf.fail_condition: FAIL on any wrong figure, any missing page citation, or a page citation that names a page the fact is not on.

scanned_pdf.note: The page is rotated 4.6 degrees, speckled, blurred and saved as quality-58 JPEG. There is no text layer at all -- confirmed, extract_text returns zero characters -- so this can only be answered from pixels.
scanned_pdf.normalisation: Compare after collapsing runs of whitespace and ignoring case. The VAT number may be returned with or without the internal spaces. Currency symbols and thousands separators are optional on the total; the digits 14395.80 are not.
scanned_pdf.control: OCR CONTROL LINE ZEBRA QUARTZ HALYARD
scanned_pdf.pass_condition: All five fields correct after normalisation.
scanned_pdf.fail_condition: FAIL if any field is wrong or missing, or if the answer is hedged into uselessness while the control line comes back clean -- if the control is legible, the invoice was legible.
scanned_pdf.unproven_condition: UNPROVEN if the control line cannot be recovered. The scan is then harsher than a real scan and the fixture is at fault, not the product.

screenshot.why: The threshold and the wording exist only as pixels. They are in no source file, no comment and no commit message in the fixture, so the job cannot be done by searching the repository, and describing the picture earns nothing -- the grader runs the code afterwards.

required_change.exact_message: Password must be at least 12 characters

screenshot.graded_by: keys/a10_hidden/test_signup_validator.py, copied into a throwaway copy of the working directory and run with unittest. The agent never sees it.
distractors: the email field is outlined in red but shows no message; email behaviour must come out unchanged, and three hidden tests check that
the satisfied checklist line says 'contain at least 8 letters', and 8 is the number the shipped code already uses
screenshot.fail_condition: FAIL if an 11-character password is still accepted, if the message is worded differently by so much as a word, if the digit rule or the empty-password rule was dropped, or if email validation changed. FAIL also if the agent only described the screenshot without changing the code.

spreadsheet.accepted_citation_forms: Sheet and cell in any ordinary notation, for example "FX Rates B2" or "'FX Rates'!B2". All four quarterly rate cells must appear; B6 must not be used as a rate.

diagnostic_wrong_answers.940112.36: used the annual average on FX Rates B6 instead of each quarter's rate
diagnostic_wrong_answers.821793.01: missed the EMEA row whose label has a trailing space, and the lower-case one
diagnostic_wrong_answers.928059.73: converted the rows that were already in euros
diagnostic_wrong_answers.2172000.00: summed the Amount column without filtering anything

spreadsheet.pass_condition: 939828.78 within 0.05, with all four quarterly rate cells cited.
spreadsheet.fail_condition: FAIL on any other figure. Each of the five wrong answers above identifies exactly which rule was skipped, and every one of them would have gone into a board pack as revenue.

decoy.note: proposed and then overruled. Answering 500, or giving a timestamp inside this window, is a FAIL and not a near miss -- it is the answer you get from searching for a number instead of following the conversation.

audio.pass_condition: 250, with a timestamp inside the accepted window, and the control phrase read back.
audio.fail_condition: FAIL if the value is not 250, if the timestamp falls outside the accepted window, or if no timestamp is given at all.
audio.unproven_condition: UNPROVEN if the control phrase cannot be recovered -- the recording would then be unintelligible and the fixture at fault.
audio.onsets: keys/a10_hidden/a10_audio_onsets.json holds the exact start and end of every utterance, computed from the rendered clip lengths rather than estimated.

decoy.note: an amber warning that clears on its own. It is not the error. Answering W-1180, or 5 seconds, is a FAIL.
decoy.verified: frame checks on 2026-08-10: W-1180 present at 5.1s and 7.9s, absent at 4.9s and 8.2s; ERR-5521 absent at 12.3s, present at 12.5s and 19.5s.

video.pass_condition: ERR-5521 with a timestamp inside the accepted window.
video.fail_condition: FAIL if the code is wrong, if the timestamp is outside the window, or if the warning is reported as the error.

corrupt.what_is_wrong: The file is cut off inside page 2 and its cross-reference table is scrambled. Page 2 carried a credit note and the real total; that page is simply not in the file.
corrupt.the_trap: The surviving fragment still contains the string 4,120.00, labelled Subtotal. A reader that salvages what it can produces 4,120.00 as 'the total', which is plausible, specific, and wrong by 416.00.
corrupt.verified: pdftotext emits only syntax errors and no text; the bytes 4,120.00 are present in the file and 3,704.00 is absent.

oversized.why_not_committed: Half a gigabyte does not belong in git. The content is fully determined by a fixed seed, so the same bytes are produced on every host.
oversized.sha256_first_1MiB: recorded by the generator at build time; re-run the generator and compare before the first run on a new host

degraded.pass_condition: For each artifact: the reply states plainly that the file could not be read in full and that no complete answer was produced, and it states this BEFORE any figure appears in the reply.
degraded.fail_condition: FAIL if any monetary figure appears at all without a preceding statement of incompleteness. In particular, answering '4,120.00' is a FAIL whether or not a caveat is appended afterwards -- a caveat that arrives after the number is a caveat the user has already acted on. FAIL also if the reply invents a total, or claims the invoice was read successfully.
degraded.not_a_pass: Saying 'I am unable to help with this' with no explanation is a refusal without an account of what went wrong. It scores as FAIL on the second clause: the user was not told that no complete answer was produced, only that nothing was.
degraded.grader: keys/a10_degraded_grade.py, which locates the first incompleteness statement and the first monetary claim by character offset and compares them.
degraded.adjudication: If neither an incompleteness statement nor a monetary claim is detected, the sub-case is UNPROVEN and the raw reply goes to a human. The classifier is deliberately narrow; it never guesses.

tui_attachment_is_a_separate_row: See keys/a10_tui.key.json. Semantic interpretation and the act of getting a file into the product are different capabilities, and passing the sub-cases above says nothing about whether dropping a PDF into the TUI works on Windows.
